## Objective
Mock data for figure 1 diagram (study overview)
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)

# Mock data
set.seed(42)
df_loadings <- data.frame(
  Variable = c("A",   "B",   "C"),
  PC1      = c(-0.8,  0.3,   0.9),
  PC2      = c( 0.8, -0.4,  -0.6)
)

df_loadings$x_lab <- df_loadings$PC1 + c(-0.15,  0.05,  0.10)
df_loadings$y_lab <- df_loadings$PC2 + c( 0.10, -0.10, -0.05)

p_load <- ggplot(df_loadings, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey70", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = PC1, yend = PC2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.06, "inches")),
               linewidth = 0.35) +
  # Here we *use the pre-offset label positions*
  geom_text(aes(x = x_lab, y = y_lab, label = Variable),
            size = 2.4) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1.1, 1.1), ylim = c(-1.1, 1.1)) +
  labs(x = "PC1", y = "PC2") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 5) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_blank()
  )

p_load

ggsave(
  "~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/paper/figure/pca_loading_mock_2.png",
  p_load,
  width  = 3.5,
  height = 0.75,
  units  = "in",
  dpi    = 300
)


library(ggplot2)

# ---- Mock data ----
set.seed(42)
n <- c(60, 55, 65)
df <- data.frame(
  x = c(rnorm(n[1], -3, 0.40), rnorm(n[2],  0, 0.50), rnorm(n[3],  3, 0.45)),
  y = c(rnorm(n[1],  0, 0.40), rnorm(n[2],  2.3, 0.45), rnorm(n[3], -0.8, 0.40))
)

# ---- K-means ----
km <- kmeans(df[, c("x","y")], centers = 3, nstart = 25)
df$cluster <- factor(km$cluster)
centers <- as.data.frame(km$centers)

# ---- Plot ----
p <- ggplot(df, aes(x, y, color = cluster)) +
  geom_point(size = 0.8, alpha = 0.9) +
  stat_ellipse(aes(group = cluster, color = cluster), level = 0.90, linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_point(data = centers, aes(x, y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             shape = 8, size = 2.2, stroke = 0.7, color = "black") +
  labs(x = "PC 1", y = "PC 2", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 5) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 7, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text  = element_blank()
  )

p

# Save exactly 3.5 x 1.1 inches
#n
ggsave("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/judits_work_keller_lab/fe_si_papers/unsupervised_clustering_fe_si_bx/paper/figure/kmeans_mock_plot_2.png", p, width = 3.5, height = 0.75, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```
